title: HumanUnsealingAuthorizationV1
description: Preregistered schema for one-time human authorization artifact required to unseal locked-test partition.

status.description: Must be strictly AUTHORIZED to permit locked-test unsealing.

authorization_id.description: Unique identifier for this human authorization.

authorized_by.description: Identity, role, or institutional affiliation of the authorizer.

authorized_at_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when authorization was executed.

candidate_protocol.description: Candidate protocol locked during Phase 4C.2E preregistration.

sample_size.description: Maximum development sample size principle locked in preregistration.

checkpoint_sha256s.description: Cryptographic SHA-256 digests for all 5 candidate checkpoints.

evaluator_functional_commit.description: Canonical functional commit hash of the confirmatory evaluator.

evaluator_component_hashes.description: SHA-256 digests of canonical evaluator source components.

maximum_unsealing_sessions.description: Hard limit on total unsealing sessions (exactly 1).

maximum_model_evaluation_attempts.description: Hard limit on evaluation attempts across the 5 candidate checkpoints (exactly 5).

no_tuning_acknowledgment.description: Irrevocable acknowledgment that no model tuning, threshold tuning, or hyperparameter selection will occur on locked-test.
